free_tier.stated: Per-account UNLIMITED. Per-file: 103809024 bytes = 99 MiB (video), 16 MiB image on almost every stock instance. mastodonapp.uk raises the IMAGE cap to 99 MiB too, which is the unusual bit.

egress.terms: Free. Media is offloaded to plain S3-compatible buckets behind the instance domain. Verified on two live instances: mastodon.world serves from `s3.eu-central-2.wasabisys.com/mastodonworld/..` (Wasabi), mstdn.jp serves from `img.mstdn.jp/media_attachments/files/..`.

record.tooling: Mastodon REST API v1; `toot` CLI; Mastodon.py; Mastodon-API clients in every language.
record.chaining: Standard Mastodon instances enforce per-file limits (typically 40 to 99 MiB) and rate limits (30 uploads per 30 minutes) rather than aggregate account quotas. Media is hosted by instance storage nodes and distributed via federation.
record.limits_note: mastodonapp.uk: image_size_limit and video_size_limit both 103809024 bytes (99 MiB), 4 media attachments per status; per-account unlimited and the API call rates are unverified on this host

identity_cost.detail: mastodonapp.uk sign-up steps: accept rules, your details, confirm email, review by the moderators; no phone or card step is listed

record.reliability_note: Registration state varies per instance and flips often. Mastodon.social, mstdn.social, mstdn.jp, mastodon.world, mastodon.gamedev.place all reported registrations=true at probe time; mas.to, fosstodon.org, chaos.social, toot.community, mastodon.online reported false. Re-probe before relying on any one.
record.confidence_note: documented: the image and video size limits and the attachments per status are quoted from https://mastodonapp.uk/api/v2/instance; the sign-up steps from https://mastodonapp.uk/auth/sign_up; the image size limit of a stock instance from https://mastodon.social/api/v2/instance; the media upload rate limit from https://docs.joinmastodon.org/api/rate-limits/ (read 2026-11-03)
